title: Flamethrower
body:
"A true marvel of technology! Burn trees, melt ice, cause chaos. Takes 1 minute to recharge."


Description

The Flamethrower is a highly expensive item used commonly to get into caves or the Aurora Tools. Players can easily make their money back after getting this item, as Sapphire Cave is highly profitable. Located in the basement of Gizmo's Observatory for $323,420.

Appearance

Looks how you would commonly expect a flamethrower to look, when holding it, it glows slightly orange. This glow gets brighter when using the flamethrower.

Trivia

  • The Flamethrower was added on December 1st of 2024, along with the Christmas update.
  • The Flamethrower is currently located in the basement of Gizmo's Observatory
  • The Flamethrower can be used to turn almost any tree into an Ash Tree. (Magma and Ash Trees are unaffected)=
  • The Flamethower may be a reference to the Flamethrower from Team Fortress Two.
  • alternative icethrower
